basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) has notified 1 temporary vacancy for the post of Visiting Consultant (Horticulture). Eligible candidates holding a Bachelor’s degree in Horticulture, Agriculture, Forestry, Landscaping or a closely related discipline can apply by email on or before 1 November 2026 up to 5:30 PM. The notified honorarium for the post is Rs. 7,000 per visit, which includes transportation charges. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must apply through email at [email protected] on or before November 1, 2026, up to 5:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Horticulture, Agriculture, Forestry, Landscaping or a closely related discipline from a recognized University/ Institute. Desirable Qualifications: Ph.D. in Horticulture/ Agriculture Sciences or specialized training/ Certification in Landscape Design, Urban Forestry or protected Cultivation. Minimum Experience: 10 years of professional experience in horticulture, landscape management, nursery management, or green infrastructure projects in government departments, autonomous bodies, public sector undertakings, or large educational/corporate campuses. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore Visiting Consultant (Horticulture) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by email is November 1, 2026, up to 05:00 PM (IST).

faq.question: Q2. What is the honorarium offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected visiting consultant will receive an honorarium of ₹7,000/- per visit, which includes transportation charges.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Horticulture, Agriculture, Forestry, Landscaping, or a closely related discipline from a recognized University or Institute.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an age limit specified for applicants?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must be a minimum of 40 years of age, with experience reckoned on the last date of submission of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be enclosed with the application email?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose an updated CV clearly mentioning age, qualification, and experience details with a self-attested set of photocopies, along with a list of three references with complete contact details.
